title: Landslide, flash flood kill 6 in Kerala amid heavy rain alert - video

With heavy rainfall anticipated for the next 24 hours, an orange alert has been placed for Idukki.

title: Atlanta man arrested after phone wipe; new ruling allows border searches
content: US border agents can now search traveler cellphones without reasonable suspicion or a warrant. A recent court ruling affirmed this broad authority at international borders. This decision follows an incident where a phone was wiped during an airport search. The ruling impacts traveler privacy and government access to electronic data. It highlights ongoing debates about digital device searches at the border.

title: Meet Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, eighth-grader who designed controlled-release antacid
content: An eighth-grade student from Pennsylvania, Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, has become a national finalist for her groundbreaking GERD drug delivery system. She created an innovative controlled release mechanism aimed at prolonging the effectiveness of antacid medications. This recognition follows her success at regional science fairs, and she will vie for educational accolades in Washington, D.C. in October, showcasing her dedication to improving heartburn treatment outcomes.

title: 46-year-old man found dead inside luxury car in Bengaluru
content: A 46-year-old man was found dead in a high-end vehicle on Sunday morning. Identified as Salim Akbar from Kodagu, he was discovered unresponsive. Initial investigations and security camera footage revealed the car had been parked near a restaurant around 2:30 am. While authorities are awaiting further reports, they suspect health issues may have played a role in the death, with no indications of foul play.

title: ‘When do I blow entire nation up?' Trump's ultimatum after Iran warns of 'decisive war'
content: President Trump warned Iran of serious consequences if it does not change course.  He outlined options including destruction, economic collapse, or diplomacy with Iran.  Iran's command stated any US attack would face retaliation without limitations.  Iran relayed truce conditions to the US through Qatari mediators.  Trump signaled openness to talks with Iranian President Pezeshkian.

title: Russia wraps up first wartime parliamentary election, Kremlin set to retain control
content: Russia's parliamentary elections concluded on Sunday, projecting that the United Russia party will continue to rule. This election was marred by a heavy clampdown on opposition and dissent, alongside controversial voting in Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia. Ukraine condemned these actions, leading to international outcry, as numerous watchdogs deemed the election illegal under global treaties. Results are anticipated soon after the conclusion of voting in western Russia.

title: 'Could change a lot': Zelenskky and Trump to meet in New York ahead of UNGA
content: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and US President Trump have agreed to a crucial meeting in New York, coinciding with the UN General Assembly. Zelenskyy thanked the US special envoys for their recent visit to Kyiv. During their discussion, the leaders emphasized the importance of security issues and outlined steps towards de-escalation, signaling a collaborative approach towards a stable future for Ukraine.

title: Michael Dell’s $10.9m Boston penthouse heads to auction with $6.5m reserve
content: Michael Dell's luxurious penthouse in Boston is hitting the auction block with a starting bid of $6.5 million. Initially acquired for $10.9 million a decade ago, this stunning property is situated on the 59th floor of the renowned Millennium Tower. Following several attempts at traditional sale routes, Dell has opted for an auction format that wraps up in late October, making it a must-watch event for high-end real estate enthusiasts.

title: Couple built $40,000 home with YouTube, sold it for $290,000 and moved to Florida
content: After building a budget-friendly home in New York for just $40,000 and selling it for a striking $290,000, a couple made a spontaneous decision to relocate to Florida. Without job commitments in place, Jessica Patrzyk transitioned into real estate, while her husband chased his passion as a diving instructor. As they explore Florida’s delights and face new career paths, they also navigate the complexities of stricter local building codes.

title: Washington couple spent $50m on Lake Washington retreat; now asks $71m
content: Dwayne and Terese Clark are selling their Lake Washington estate for seventy-one million dollars. This waterfront compound features two Mediterranean-style residences on two point three acres. The property includes a main house and a separate wellness retreat with pools. They are relocating to Arizona after investing fifty million dollars into the homes. The sale could set a new record for Pacific Northwest residential real estate.

title: Healthcare goes digital: When doctors go behind the app wall, who gets left behind?
content: Digital healthcare presents a dual landscape, offering innovative benefits while simultaneously imposing hurdles for various patients. Younger generations tend to embrace online health services with ease, yet reliable internet access and digital literacy remain essential for comprehensive medical support. Initiatives such as ABHA strive to digitally integrate healthcare systems. Ultimately, technology should serve to enhance, rather than substitute, the necessary human touch in patient care.

title: How Jordon Hudson became an important part of Bill Belichick’s life
content: Bill Belichick rarely discusses his personal life, making his comments about Jordon Hudson particularly notable. During a 2025 interview, he praised Hudson as “terrific” and “very helpful,” explaining that she supported him with business matters and his book while he focused on coaching at North Carolina. His remarks offered a glimpse into their relationship, emphasizing companionship, trust, support, and mutual perspective.

title: Vince and Linda McMahon net worth 2026: How they built their fortune
content: Vince and Linda McMahon built a global sports entertainment empire from a regional wrestling company. Their combined net worth is estimated at $3.2 billion, largely from WWE. WWE merged with UFC in 2023, creating TKO Group Holdings. Vince McMahon retains a significant stake in TKO, while Linda pursued politics. The couple also holds substantial real estate and other investments.

title: China's 13-year-old swimmer breaks Asian Games record, wins 200m butterfly gold
content: The 13-year-old, who turns 14 next month, clocked 2:05.08 to break the Asian Games record set by China's Zhang Yufei at the Hangzhou Games three years ago. Zhang had won the event in 2:05.57, and Yu finished nearly half a second quicker.

title: BJP, Congress trade barbs over PM Modi mimicry at Rahul Gandhi’s Indore event
content: The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized the Congress party after a comedian mimicked Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This performance occurred during an event attended by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi in Madhya Pradesh. Union ministers and other BJP leaders targeted the opposition party and the Congress MP over the skit. Congress leaders defended the program, stating that all mothers deserve respect and questioning BJP's selective outrage.

title: Italy to limit foreign students, ban burqa and hijab in schools
content: In a bold move, Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni unveiled new regulations for schools, prohibiting face coverings such as burqas and niqabs in classrooms. The initiative also sets a limit on foreign students per class and requires parents of foreign students to learn Italian, promoting integration and ensuring that Italian children feel at home, rather than a minority in their own schools.

title: Hidden cameras, dark web: Self-styled godman held in TN for sexually abusing women
content: Authorities took a self-proclaimed godman into custody after uncovering disturbing allegations of sexual abuse towards women and minors. This heinous act came to light following an attempted assault on a schoolgirl who was fundraising. Investigators discovered more than fifty explicit videos stored on his laptop, with Vijayaraja admitting to selling these recordings to an online platform for profit.

title: ‘Path of deception closed’: Iran vows ‘no limits’ in retaliation if US attacks
content: Iran has issued a stern warning, promising unlimited retaliation and a decisive conflict if the US attacks or dismisses its demands. Through Qatari mediators, Tehran has proposed seven conditions for a truce to Washington. Officials in Iran stressed that any regional nations supporting the US would be drawn into the conflict. Parliament speaker Ghalibaf reiterated the dual approach of military readiness alongside diplomatic negotiations.

title: How TTD plans to unlock value from land and strengthen its financial systems
content: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India is working with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams on several key projects. These initiatives include monetizing land assets through real estate investment trusts and valuing gold holdings. An updated accounting manual for the temple trust is also nearing completion by the institute. This comprehensive manual will cover all aspects of TTD's financial operations and collections.

title: Asian Games Day 1 Medal Tally: Where India rank after two silvers in Aichi-Nagoya
content: India made a striking start at the Asian Games, capturing two silver medals in shooting events. Elavenil Valarivan was a standout, winning silvers both individually and as part of the team in the 10m air rifle competition. Additionally, the women's cricket team powered through to the finals, showcasing their strength, along with commendable starts from the hockey and table tennis teams, who also secured significant victories.

title: 'Brahmastra' actor in judicial custody after woman files complaint over marriage promise

After meeting on Instagram and developing a relationship via WhatsApp, they lived together in the US and India, where Gurjar allegedly persuaded her to leave her job. Police have initiated an investigation into the actor's actions.

title: Asian Games: India open account with 2 shooting silvers as hockey, cricket, MMA shine

Badminton and table tennis teams also delivered strong performances on the opening day.

title: Trump adds drones, snipers and ammunition to plans for Washington triumphal arch

The structure is planned near Arlington Memorial Bridge, adjacent to the cemetery. Veterans have filed lawsuits challenging the arch's construction and sightline disruption. The Federal Aviation Administration has cleared aviation concerns for the proposed arch.

title: '27,000 votes, 27 seats': Akhilesh lays out SP strategy to counter BJP in UP polls
content: akhilesh says the party has set a target of increasing its vote share by 27,000 votes for his marked 27 assembly constituencies in Uttar Pradesh . he also accused the BJP of leaving people across sections of society unhappy during its decade in power .

title: ‘People dying, yet crores spent on PM Modi’s birthday’: Tejashwi on Bihar floods
content: RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav criticised BJP-led government for spending 'crores of rupees' on events to mark prime minister's birthday . rainfall has been less than 35% this time, causing a part of Bihar to face drought-like conditions .

title: Annamalai rejects Periyar’s anti-Brahmin views, backs his stand on women’s liberation
content: former BJP chief says he "completely rejects" the "atheistic and anti-Brahmin" ideologies espoused by EV Ramasamy . he acknowledges the Dravidian stalwart's contributions to women's empowerment and the fight against caste discrimination .

title: From BJP veteran Advani to Kejriwal: High-profile names get Delhi SIR notices
content: BJP stalwart LK Advani and former deputy chief minister manish Sisodia are among the prominent voters whose names figure in the list of 33 lakh people being issued notices . their names will be included in the final electoral rolls after due process of verification of facts and documents to be furnished .

title: Why Alberta wants out of Canada and how Trump’s ‘51st state’ idea fits in
content: the country's fourth-largest province will vote on whether its government should start the legal process required to hold a binding referendum on whether Alberta should separate from Canada . a “yes” vote will not make Alberta an independent country . there will be no new border posts on the trans-Canada Highway and Calgary will not suddenly become the capital of a new nation .

title: New Jersey couple gave away 90-acre estate; land is now a free public preserve
content: the 90-acre Scudder Preserve, in the Navesink section of Middletown, was officially accredited in July as a Level I Arboretum by ArbNet . among its many treasures are a state-designated 201-year-old tulip tree, rare American chestnuts, immense white oaks and abundant wildlife, all of which the public is welcome to enjoy .

title: 'Largest-ever' attack: Ukraine launches over 1,000 drones at Russia, oil refinery hit
content: two people were killed and 20 injured across the wider Moscow region, local governor says . the strikes also damaged a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building . a mother and her two children were killed in an overnight drone attack near Kyiv .

content: the question has come into focus after BJP home minister's assertion that the Uniform Civil Code would be implemented in all 21 NDA-ruled states . the issue surfaced after Shah put a timeline on BJP's plan to implement one of its longstanding ideological objectives before the 2029 Lok Sabha polls . he said he is confident that in the 21 BJP-NDA ruled states we will introduce the UCC before 2029 .

title: MAGA brown-out: For Indian Trump acolytes, citizenship comes with an asterisk
content: conservatives in the Trump orbit have comforted themselves that race doesn't matter, ideology does . they are now discovering a rather inconvenient footnote: in the MAGA world, you can pass the ideological exam and still fail the race test and dinner evaluation . conservatives have invited ridicule from MAGA trolls, as has Dinesh D’Souza’s attempt to defend his daughter from racist attacks .

title: Initial fuel loading begins at Rajasthan Atomic Power Project’s units 7 and 8
content: nuclear power Corporation of India Ltd (NPCIL) commenced initial fuel loading of the 700MWe Rajasthan Atomic Power Stations units RAPP-7 and RAPP-8 at Rawatbhata . the process began after receiving clearance from the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board following rigorous safety evaluations and major system integrity audits .

title: 93% of deleted Bengal voters have won appeals, EC tells SC
content: EC asserted that exclusions didn’t affect outcome of assembly polls . around 93% of those whose cases have been decided over not being able to vote in the polls this year because of doubts raised about their eligibility during Election Commission's SIR drive have won their appeals and have been included in the electoral roll . 8,649 of 1.2 lakh lost their appeal and will be deleted .

title: US prepares sweeping sanctions on International Criminal Court
content: the measures would take effect after a six- to seven-month grace period . transactions involving communications services would be exempt . a state department spokesperson pointed to a view that the ICC threatens US sovereignty .
